text_blocks.snippet: PTSD, or Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder, is a mental health condition triggered by experiencing or witnessing a traumatic event. Common symptoms include intrusive memories like flashbacks and nightmares, avoidance behaviors, negative changes in thinking and mood, and heightened reactivity. These symptoms can significantly impact a person's daily life, affecting their ability to function at work, school, or in relationships.
